sources.title: GitHub - ftwig/mining-ai: AI-powered chatbot for Indian mining laws and ...
sources.snippet: An AI-powered chatbot for querying Indian mining laws and regulations. The application uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to retrieve relevant sections from mining regulation documents and generate answers using a local LLM.

sources.title: MineBot: AI-Powered Mining Laws and Regulations Chatbot
sources.snippet: The system is a combination of a vector-based legal knowledge base with a Large Language Model to provide factual consistency and permit. The chatbot contains information about key mining legislations such as the Coal Mines Act of 1952, the Indian Explosives Act, 1884, and land acquisition provisions.

sources.title: Mining-regulation Chatbot - a Hugging Face Space by asif001
sources.snippet: This chatbot helps you get answers to questions about mining rules and regulations. Just type your question, and it will provide a relevant response based on a dataset of mining regulations.

The chatbot will utilize AI and natural language processing to provide stakeholders with accurate and timely responses to their queries about mining regulations.
